title: 맨발, 첫눈, 새해: 앞에 붙는 말로 낱말 늘리기
objective: By the end, you can understand the meanings of 맨-, 헛-, 첫-, and 새- and use ten words with them, such as 맨발, 첫인상, 첫눈, and 새해, in short sentences.
summary: Learn ten everyday words made with 맨- (bare; in 맨처음, 'the very'), 헛- (in vain, empty), 첫- (first), and 새- (new).

task.title: Use the prefix words
task.line: Read each item and choose, write, or arrange the word that fits, using the ten words on page 1.

words.exampleMeaning: At home, I usually walk around barefoot.
At the very beginning, Korean was too difficult.

words.meaning: nonsense; talk that makes no sense
words.exampleMeaning: I must have talked nonsense because I was so tired.
My first impression of that person was very good.
I'm moving to a new house next month.
Do you still remember your first love?

words.meaning: the first snow of the winter
words.exampleMeaning: Let's meet when the first snow falls.
It was my first day at the company, so I was very nervous.
Happy New Year. (lit. Receive a lot of luck in the new year.)

words.example: 이 가방은 오래 썼는데 아직 새것 같아요.
words.exampleMeaning: I've used this bag for a long time, but it still looks brand-new.

exercises: Choose the right prefix (맨, 헛, 첫, 새): ① 아이가 ____발로 모래 위를 뛰어다녀요. ② 오늘이 방학 ____날이에요. ③ ____해에는 운동을 시작하려고 해요. ④ 고등학교 때 ____사랑을 길에서 우연히 만났어요.
Fill in the blank with one word from page 1: 면접에서 만난 사람의 ____이 아주 좋았어요.
Write the word that matches each meaning: ① 한 번도 안 쓴 물건 ② 가장 처음 ③ 새로 지은 집
Is the word used correctly? Write O or X: ① 12월 초에 첫눈이 왔어요. ② 친구가 헛소리를 해서 정말 고마웠어요. ③ 새해 첫날에 가족과 떡국을 먹었어요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 내리고 있어요 / 첫눈이 / 창문 밖에
Answer in Korean using 헛소리: 친구가 "나 어제 달에 갔다 왔어."라고 했어요. 친구 말이 어때요?
answers: ① 맨 ② 첫 ③ 새 ④ 첫
① 새것 ② 맨처음 ③ 새집
① O ② X ③ O
창문 밖에 첫눈이 내리고 있어요. (첫눈이 창문 밖에 내리고 있어요.)
